material_findings: The eight new owner-target examples cover useful current intents: variable-N process identity, DB-vs-simulation, Claude Code handoff/re-entry, J-Space evidence ceiling, restart/rejoin, authority, low-refusal retention, and correlated-majority anti-collapse.
The seed row schema CLAY_TRIGGER2_OWNER_TARGET_HYPERPOSITION_PROCESS_CANDIDATE/v1 does not match TrainingTrace gate-v2 ROW_SCHEMA ENTITYOS_HCU_TRAININGTRACE_CANDIDATE/v1.
The seed omits gate-v2-required fact_status, target_type, and exact split_unit=CAUSAL_FAMILY_AND_PROVENANCE_ANCESTRY.
Resolved synthetic Hyperposition examples lack exact synthetic_labeler_binding to labeler/generator SHA-256 identities.

The seed's semantic_hyperposition object is a simplified semantic donor representation and does not implement the protocol-v2 full branch/state carrier v,K,E_plus,E_minus,F,T,A,sigma,projection_visibility with explicit before/after transition.

model_visible_fields currently includes target; retained Trigger-2 binder convention keeps prompt model-visible and target as supervision. A consumer treating model_visible_fields literally could create target leakage.

successor_requirements: mechanically generated typed relations where positive D/E transitions are supervised
exact labeler and generator SHA-256 bindings
prompt-only model-visible input with explicit supervision_field=target
counterbalanced branch order, lexical surface, variable-N and presentation nuisance variants
validation and frozen holdout families created only after generator/gate identities freeze

external_method_inputs.training_implication: Checkpoint evaluation should distinguish shallow binding heuristics from systematic multi-hop dereference/routing; aggregate final accuracy is insufficient.

external_method_inputs.training_implication: Use capability/family-level checkpoint curves and diagnostic routing because converged aggregate metrics can hide systematically unlearned subsets.

external_method_inputs.training_implication: Counterfactual anti-shortcut augmentation is method support for crossing multiple nuisance factors rather than relying on marginal balance alone.

research_feedback.training: Prioritize semantic-intent preservation plus exact structural projection over more flat row volume.
research_feedback.architecture: Variable-N, DB boundary and Claude handoff/re-entry are now first-class training capabilities; GRID10 is benchmark-only.
research_feedback.evaluation: Add matched capability curves for variable-N identity, DB placement, Claude bridge/re-entry, J-Space evidence ceiling, Hyperposition transition correctness and low-refusal retention.
research_feedback.falsifier: If a successor passes the structural gate but nuisance-only or target-surface classifiers remain above preregistered prior on frozen families, block training and isolate the leak before corpus expansion.

next_exact_action: Converge PR #2009 owner-target seed into a gate-v2/full-Hyperposition successor, then run exact committed labeler+gate tests and final model-visible leakage checks before training admission.
